name: skill-board
description: Sanjeev's skill-board pack: an autonomous GitHub Project board runner and its lane skills.

plugins.name: skill-board
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner: skill-board, super-build, super-qa, super-review, super-collect, visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (security pass on every PR; onboard adds Cloudflare's on-demand security-audit). After install, run /skill-board onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows a plugin cannot ship.
